<script>
(function () {
  var screens = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.hp-screen'));
  var steps = screens.filter(function (s) { return /^step-/.test(s.id); }), n = steps.length;
  var count = document.getElementById('hp-count'), jump = document.querySelector('.hp-jump');
  var key = "pm-home-step:" + location.pathname.split('/').pop();
  if (!n || !count) return;
  document.body.classList.add('hp-one');
  function store(i) {
    try { if (i) { sessionStorage.setItem(key, String(i)); } else { sessionStorage.removeItem(key); } } catch (e) {}
  }
  function stored() {
    try { var v = +sessionStorage.getItem(key); return v >= 1 && v <= n ? v : 0; } catch (e) { return 0; }
  }
  function nameOf(i) { return steps[i - 1].getAttribute('data-name'); }
  function show(first) {
    var m = /^#(step-(\d+)|done|start)$/.exec(location.hash), id = m ? m[1] : 'start', at = 0;
    if (m && m[2]) { at = +m[2]; if (at < 1 || at > n) { id = 'start'; at = 0; } }
    screens.forEach(function (s) { s.hidden = s.id !== id; });
    count.textContent = at ? "Step {i} of {n}".replace('{i}', at).replace('{n}', n) : '';
    [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.hp-go-step'), function (a) {
      if (a.getAttribute('href') === '#step-' + at) { a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step'); }
      else { a.removeAttribute('aria-current'); }
    });
    if (jump) jump.open = false;
    var resume = document.getElementById('hp-resume'), was = stored();
    if (resume) {
      resume.hidden = !(first && id === 'start' && !m && was);
      if (!resume.hidden) {
        resume.querySelector('p').textContent = "You were on step {i}: {name}.".replace('{i}', was).replace('{name}', nameOf(was));
        var go = resume.querySelector('.go');
        go.setAttribute('href', '#step-' + was);
        go.textContent = "Go on from step {i}".replace('{i}', was);
      }
    }
    if (at) { store(at); } else if (id === 'done') { store(0); }
    if (!first) { window.scrollTo(0, 0); var here = document.getElementById(id); if (here) here.focus(); }
    // opened straight on a screen: the browser's own jump to its id would hide the page's top (title, Step i of n)
    if (first && m) window.addEventListener('load', function () { setTimeout(function () { window.scrollTo(0, 0); }, 0); });
  }
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function () { show(false); });
  var over = document.getElementById('hp-over');
  if (over) over.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault(); store(0); document.getElementById('hp-resume').hidden = true;
  });
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.hp-ticks'), function (list) {
    var line = list.nextElementSibling, boxes = list.querySelectorAll('input');
    list.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var k = [].filter.call(boxes, function (b) { return b.checked; }).length;
      line.textContent = "{k} of {n} ticked. Ticks clear when you leave this page.".replace('{k}', k).replace('{n}', boxes.length);
    });
  });
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.hp-open'), function (a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var big = document.createElement('div'), bar = document.createElement('div'), close = document.createElement('button');
      var img = document.createElement('img'), hint = document.createElement('p');
      big.className = 'hp-large'; big.setAttribute('role', 'dialog'); bar.className = 'bar';
      var label = a.closest('.hp-screen').querySelector('.hp-label');
      if (label) bar.appendChild(label.cloneNode(true));
      close.type = 'button'; close.textContent = "Close"; bar.appendChild(close);
      img.src = a.getAttribute('href'); img.alt = a.parentNode.querySelector('img').alt;
      hint.className = 'hp-small hint'; hint.textContent = "Pinch to zoom.";
      big.appendChild(bar); big.appendChild(img); big.appendChild(hint);
      document.body.appendChild(big); close.focus();
      close.addEventListener('click', function () { document.body.removeChild(big); a.focus(); });
    });
  });
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.hp-screen video'), function (v) {
    v.addEventListener('error', function () {
      var note = v.closest('.hp-screen').querySelector('.no-video');
      if (note) note.hidden = false;
      v.parentNode.hidden = true;
    }, true);
  });
  show(true);
})();
</script>
